content: I understand your Power Widget Pro has stopped working. I can offer you a replacement — would that work for you?

Look, a replacement is a last resort. I'm not interested in swapping out hardware if it's just a buggy firmware build. I’ve already performed a hard factory reset and swapped the power delivery cables with known-good ones, and the intermittent drops persist. 

Before we jump to an RMA, can you actually tell me what changed in the latest firmware update? I suspect there’s a regression in the power management profile, but I haven't been able to roll back to the previous stable version to confirm.
